Over 200 Aldermen Appointed Across 32 Urban Bodies

More than 200 aldermen have been appointed across 32 urban local bodies. Raipur Municipal Corporation saw the highest number of appointments with 11 aldermen. Other notable appointments include 9 in Ambikapur Municipal Corporation and 3 each in Lakhanpur and Sitapur. These appointments affect various urban areas, including those in the Surguja division.
